commands.name: graph
commands.description: Print the application's capability graph (forwards to 'dotnet run -- graph').

commands.name: invoke
commands.description: Invoke an operation of the application (forwards to 'dotnet run -- invoke'); '<resource> <verb>' is a shorthand.

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Serve the offline XiHan Framework knowledge base (packages, manifests, configuration keys, docs) as an MCP server over stdio.

commands.name: migrate
commands.description: Rewrite an application for a newer framework version using the rule set for its source version: migrate <source> [--path <dir|.csproj|.slnx>] [--fixers <ids>] [--dry-run] [--report <file>].

commands.name: operations
commands.description: List the application's operations (forwards to 'dotnet run -- operations').

commands.name: pack
commands.description: Generate deployment artifacts from xihan.app.json: pack [--manifest <path>] [--output <dir>] [--only dockerfile,kustomize,compose,aspire].

commands.name: pipeline
commands.description: Print the application's pipeline (forwards to 'dotnet run -- pipeline').

commands.name: setup
commands.description: Write the knowledge-base MCP server (and a usage skill) into an AI coding tool's project configuration: setup --client <claude|cursor|vscode|codex> [--mode mcp|skill|both] [--pin <version>] [--path <dir>] [--dry-run] [--check].

commands.name: version
commands.description:
Print the framework version.
<resource> <verb> [...]: shorthand for 'invoke <resource>.<verb>'.
